WITH state_account_bases AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_base
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_county_province, account_base,
         1.0 * account_base / SUM(account_base) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_account_bases
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(ss.account_base) AS combined_account_base,
       AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ss.share - av.avg_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM state_shares ss
CROSS JOIN average_share av
WHERE ss.share > av.avg_share;
